_comment: YOUR requirements. Shipped as an example: backend/platform SWE in India, 0-3 years asked, >= 20 LPA, Java-leaning stack. Edit title include/exclude, max_min_years, min_pay_lpa, max_age_days, stack weights, gaps and exclude_companies (add your current employer here). Regexes are matched case-insensitively against lower-cased text.

linkedin._comment: Light mode (default) is India-wide role searches plus a small company sweep: ~5-15 min, and where nearly all LinkedIn-only results come from. --deep adds per-city searches and a big sweep (hours).
linkedin._comment_liveness: Earlier LinkedIn postings not seen again are checked on LinkedIn (up to liveness_checks_per_run per pass, rechecked after liveness_recheck_days): closed ones are dropped, open ones kept at any age.

_comment_experience: Roles asking up to max_min_years are kept; 0-2 years with salary evidence is flagged as the sweet spot. Campus, new-grad and fresher hiring is excluded (title and description).
